title: Product Designer Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to become a product designer from scratch, covering research, design, and delivery. Follow the phases to build fundamentals, core skills, portfolio pieces, and job readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid understanding of design thinking and the product development process.

milestones.title: Design Mindset & Process
milestones.outcome: Can explain the stages of product design and apply a basic design thinking framework.

tasks.title: Read Design Thinking Overview
tasks.description: Study the Design Thinking model on the IDEO website and note each phase.

tasks.title: Summarize Product Lifecycle
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of how ideas move from concept to shipped product.

tasks.title: Map a Simple Product Flow
tasks.description: Sketch a flowchart for a common app (e.g., to‑do list) using pen and paper.

tasks.title: Discuss with Peer
tasks.description: Share your flowchart in a community forum (e.g., Designer Hangout) and get feedback.

milestones.title: Basics of Visual Communication
milestones.outcome: Can identify basic visual hierarchy, color, and typography principles.

tasks.title: Watch Visual Design Basics
tasks.description: View the freeCodeCamp video on visual hierarchy and take notes.

tasks.title: Create a Style Sheet
tasks.description: Define a simple style sheet with font sizes, colors, and spacing for a mock app.

tasks.title: Apply Style to Wireframe
tasks.description: Redraw a low‑fidelity wireframe using the style sheet in pen and paper.

tasks.title: Reflect on Choices
tasks.description: Write a short reflection on why you chose each visual element.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop hands‑on abilities in research, design tools, and metrics.

milestones.title: User Research Foundations
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct a basic user interview and synthesize findings.

tasks.title: Read Nielsen Norman Interview Guide
tasks.description: Study the NN/g guide on user interviews and note key steps.

tasks.title: Draft Interview Script
tasks.description: Write a 5‑question script for a target user group of a budgeting app.

tasks.title: Conduct Mock Interview
tasks.description: Pair with a friend and run the interview, recording observations.

tasks.title: Create Affinity Map
tasks.description: Organize interview notes into themes on a virtual whiteboard (Miro free tier).

tasks.title: Share Findings
tasks.description: Post a summary in a design community and solicit feedback.

milestones.title: Figma Proficiency
milestones.outcome: Can design, prototype, and hand off screens using Figma.

tasks.title: Complete Figma Basics Course
tasks.description: Follow the free Figma introductory tutorial on the Figma website.

tasks.title: Recreate a Mobile Screen
tasks.description: Build a login screen from a screenshot using Figma components.

tasks.title: Add Interactive Prototype
tasks.description: Link the login screen to a home screen with simple transitions.

tasks.title: Export Design Specs
tasks.description: Generate CSS and iOS specs for the prototype and review them.

tasks.title: Join Figma Community
tasks.description: Share your file in the Figma Community and ask for critique.

milestones.title: Metrics & Impact
milestones.outcome: Can define success metrics and interpret basic analytics for design decisions.

tasks.title: Read Intro to Product Metrics
tasks.description: Study the free article on product metrics from Mixpanel blog.

tasks.title: Define Success Metrics
tasks.description: Choose three measurable goals for the budgeting app prototype (e.g., conversion, retention).

tasks.title: Mock Data Analysis
tasks.description: Create a simple spreadsheet with sample usage data and calculate the metrics.

tasks.title: Write Metric‑Driven Recommendations
tasks.description: Draft a brief report linking design tweaks to metric improvements.

tasks.title: Discuss with Engineer
tasks.description: Explain your metrics to a peer engineer in a short chat to ensure feasibility.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate end‑to‑end design capability.

milestones.title: End‑to‑End Case Study
milestones.outcome: A complete product case study ready for a portfolio.

tasks.title: Select Real Problem
tasks.description: Identify a common pain point (e.g., grocery list sharing) to solve.

tasks.title: Conduct 2 User Interviews
tasks.description: Run two short interviews using the script from Phase 2 and record insights.

tasks.title: Sketch Solutions
tasks.description: Produce three low‑fidelity concepts on paper.

tasks.title: Design High‑Fidelity Mockups
tasks.description: Use Figma to create polished screens for the chosen concept.

tasks.title: Write Case Study Narrative
tasks.description: Document problem, research, design decisions, and outcomes in a 1500‑word story.

milestones.title: Feature Spec & Designs
milestones.outcome: A detailed spec document with annotated designs for a single feature.

tasks.title: Define Feature Scope
tasks.description: Write a one‑page spec outlining goals, users, and constraints for a new feature (e.g., dark mode).

tasks.title: Create User Flow Diagram
tasks.description: Map the end‑to‑end flow for the feature using Figma FigJam.

tasks.title: Design UI Screens
tasks.description: Produce three annotated screens in Figma showing the feature in use.

tasks.title: Add Interaction Prototype
tasks.description: Link screens to demonstrate the feature’s interaction.

tasks.title: Publish to Portfolio Site
tasks.description: Upload the spec and designs to a free portfolio platform (e.g., Behance).

milestones.title: Design Sprint Write‑up
milestones.outcome: A concise report of a 5‑day design sprint process and outcomes.

tasks.title: Plan Sprint Schedule
tasks.description: Outline a 5‑day sprint agenda for a chosen problem.

tasks.title: Facilitate Day‑1 Mapping
tasks.description: Run a mapping session with a small group (or simulate) and capture notes.

tasks.title: Sketch Solutions Day‑2
tasks.description: Generate multiple sketches and vote on the best approach.

tasks.title: Prototype Day‑3
tasks.description: Build a clickable prototype in Figma covering the core flow.

tasks.title: Test & Document Day‑4/5
tasks.description: Conduct quick usability tests, record feedback, and write a sprint summary.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced abilities, network, and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Advanced Interaction Design
milestones.outcome: Can design complex interactions and micro‑animations.

tasks.title: Study Micro‑animation Principles
tasks.description: Read the free article on micro‑interactions from Smashing Magazine.

tasks.title: Prototype Animated Button
tasks.description: Create a button with hover and click animations using Figma’s Smart Animate.

tasks.title: Test Animation with Users
tasks.description: Show the animated prototype to two users and note reactions.

tasks.title: Document Interaction Specs
tasks.description: Write a concise interaction spec for the animated component.

tasks.title: Share on Design Community
tasks.description: Post the animation case on Dribbble and request feedback.

milestones.title: Collaboration with Engineers
milestones.outcome: Can communicate design intent clearly and iterate with engineering teams.

tasks.title: Read Design‑Engineering Handbook
tasks.description: Study the free “Design + Engineering Collaboration” guide from Google Design.

tasks.title: Create Design Handoff Docs
tasks.description: Prepare a Figma handoff file with specs, assets, and notes for a feature.

tasks.title: Run a Design Review Meeting
tasks.description: Simulate a review with a peer acting as engineer, discuss constraints.

tasks.title: Iterate Based on Feedback
tasks.description: Update the design according to the mock engineer’s comments.

tasks.title: Reflect on Collaboration
tasks.description: Write a brief reflection on what worked and what to improve in future handoffs.

milestones.title: Job & Freelance Readiness
milestones.outcome: Prepared resume, portfolio, and interview strategy for product design roles.

tasks.title: Craft Design Resume
tasks.description: Write a one‑page resume highlighting projects, tools, and impact metrics.

tasks.title: Polish Portfolio Narrative
tasks.description: Refine each case study to focus on problem, process, and results.

tasks.title: Mock Interview Practice
tasks.description: Do a 30‑minute product design interview with a peer using common questions.

tasks.title: Research Target Companies
tasks.description: Create a spreadsheet of 10 companies, noting their design culture and product focus.

tasks.title: Apply to Jobs or Gigs
tasks.description: Submit applications to at least three roles or freelance listings today.
